name: In Nightmares
objectiveText: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus. Nightmare Shard (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The Talbar Mantle are awesome Twink shoulders for cloth wearers.

 For the Alliance.

Get someone to Run you through Wailing Caverns.
You need to kill all serpent lords, and then speak to the Tauren druid at the beginning of the instance itself (rather than the cave).

Then follow and protect the Tauren.
Then when it goes to the sleeping person, it will begin it's magic.
And you need to protect it for 3 waves of enemies.
The first is Deviate snake thingies
the second is slime monster thingies
and the third is a giant silver Murloc.
Defeat him, and pick up the glowing shard.

You then want to open the quest that the Glowing shard has.
you need to go to Ratchet and speak with the goblin near to the flight path goblin. he will tell you to take the shard to a Tauren Lady (Falla Sagewind) on top of the mountain that Wailing Caverns is under.
(not the cave room above the entrance to Wailing Caverns)

Speak to her, and she will tell you to go and speak with a Night Elf druid trainer Mathrengyl Bearwalker.
and he gives you the reward.

yay.

P.s: 2000xp is just for IN NIGHTMARES quest only, you get 2650xp when u turn in the glowing shard to the tauren druid on top of the mountain above wailing cavern.

Just a note: the quest description there is only for alliance. For the horde, I think you need to talk to someone on elder rise in Thunder Bluff. If you don't know where to get the shard, it's like this:
1. Clear out Wailing Caverns. That means all the bosses plus Verdan the Everling.
2. Talk to the lv. 30 elite tauren at the start of the instance. He'll say something about awakening some dude.
3. Escort the tauren through the first section of the caves. You'll pause occasionally to defend him from spawning enemies.
4. The tauren will turn left into a large alcove. You should see a night elf lying on a pedestal with green fires everywhere.
5. The tauren will start a spell to awaken his friend. During that time, there will be three waves of enemies that come from the pool. First one is four elite naga things (forgot the names). Second wave is about ten non-elite sludge dudes. The third wave is the biggest murlock you will ever see. It's level 18 I think. Anyway, the shard drops from him.
